meta.name: brainstorming
meta.description: Socratic questioning protocol + user communication. MANDATORY for complex requests, new features, or unclear requirements. Includes progress reporting and error handling.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让助手用提问式对话帮你理清需求后再动手
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常常接到模糊需求，希望助手先问你澄清再执行。
copy.tagline_en: Get your assistant to clarify needs through questioning before acting
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often get vague requirements and want the assistant to ask clarifying questions first.

howto.what: 遇到复杂、含糊或新功能请求时，Claude 先不写代码，而是至少提出 3 个问题（目的、用户、范围）澄清需求；之后会按优先级出带选项的问题，实施中报告进度、处理错误，结束给出总结与下一步。
howto.when: 遇到复杂或含糊请求、新功能开发、需求变更时触发；这些情况下会先提问澄清，再开始实现。

say.text: 我要做个带支付功能的商城，但需求没想细，你先问我三个问题再动手。
say.note: Claude 会暂停实现，按目的、用户、范围连续提问。

say.text: 请帮我梳理这个新功能的架构，先问关键问题，别急着写代码。
say.note: Claude 会动态生成有优先级和选项的问题。

say.text: 现有登录模块要改，你先确认一下改动范围再实施。
say.note: Claude 会先确认范围，再进入实现。

howto.what_en: For complex, vague, or new-feature requests, Claude stops coding and asks at least 3 questions (purpose, users, scope) before implementing, then generates prioritized questions with options, reports progress, handles errors, and summarizes with next steps.
howto.when_en: Triggers on complex or vague requests, new features, or change requests; it asks clarifying questions before implementing.

say_en.text: I want a vague online store with payments. Ask me 3 questions first.
say_en.note: Claude will pause and ask about purpose, users, and scope.

say_en.text: Help shape this new feature's architecture. Ask key questions, don't code yet.
say_en.note: Claude will generate prioritized questions with options.

say_en.text: We're changing the login module. Confirm the scope before implementing.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm scope before proceeding.
